prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-78498
prose.body:
Hi Team at Bramblecote Studio,

Hope you are having a wonderful week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-78498 for a total of 9564.47 USDC.

If payment has already been sent, please feel free to ignore this email. Otherwise, you can settle the balance by sending funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0x29cec71dbdb0e6d18f4f1e775fc289fdcd2e220b.

We really appreciate your continued partnership and look forward to continuing our great work together. Let us know if you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions.

Best regards,

Accounts Receivable
Galloway Print
